ModMetaData.name: Architect Studio - restart pass switch
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description: Empty on purpose, development only, never published. Its presence in a mod list is a condition: the two features that play a real restart of Architect Studio (write, then read in a new process) are tagged @requires on it, so they run in the pass that stages it and are skipped everywhere else. See Tests/Pickle/README.md.
